min-cost-to-connect-points.hint: Use dense Prim. Keep each unconnected point's cheapest link to the tree, updating Manhattan distances on demand.

swim-in-rising-water.hint: Use a min-heap to expand the lowest reachable elevation, tracking the largest elevation crossed before reaching the destination.

neetcode.variables: n = row count or columns of the square matrix

foreign-dictionary.hint: Compare adjacent words to create first-difference ordering edges, reject an invalid prefix ordering, then topologically sort all observed letters.

neetcode.variables: N = sum of the lengths of all the strings, V = number of unique characters (vertices), and E = number of edges

cheapest-flight-path.hint: Run k+1 rounds of Bellman–Ford relaxation, using the previous round's distances as the source of every update.

neetcode.variables: n = number of cities, m = number of flights, and k = number of stops

find-critical-and-pseudo-critical-edges-.hint: Use Kruskal to establish the minimum weight. Among equal-weight connections, find which edges have an alternative equal-weight path after lighter components are contracted. Those alternatives distinguish optional from critical edges.

build-a-matrix-with-conditions.hint: Topologically sort row and column conditions separately. If both orders exist, place each number at their intersecting positions.

neetcode.space: O(k + n + m) auxiliary; O(k^2) output

bounds: 1 ≤ above i , below i , left i , right i ≤ k

greatest-common-divisor-traversal.hint: Factor each value into distinct prime divisors and union indices sharing any prime. An SPF sieve up to M accelerates factoring.

climbing-stairs.hint: Count ways using the previous two stair counts. Each route ends in either a one-step or a two-step move.

neetcode.variables: n = number of steps

min-cost-climbing-stairs.hint: Track the minimum paid cost to reach each of the next two positions; step off from the cheaper of the two prior steps.

neetcode.variables: n = number of steps on the staircase

n-th-tribonacci-number.hint: Roll three previous values forward to generate the next Tribonacci number.

house-robber.hint: At each house compare skipping it with taking it plus the best total two positions back.

neetcode.variables: n = number of houses

house-robber-ii.hint: Handle one house directly. Compare two linear robber runs, one excluding the first house and the other excluding the last.

neetcode.variables: n = number of houses

longest-palindromic-substring.hint: Expand around each character and each gap between characters, retaining the longest interval seen. Keep just its boundaries until you return the result.

neetcode.variables: n = string length

palindromic-substrings.hint: Try every odd and even center. Expand while the outer characters match, counting one new substring for each successful expansion.

neetcode.variables: n = string length

decode-ways.hint: At each position count valid one-digit and two-digit endings. Reject leading zeros in each encoding and roll the last two DP counts.

neetcode.variables: n = string length

coin-change.hint: For every partial amount store the least coins needed. Try each denomination as the last coin. A is the target amount.

neetcode.variables: n = number of coins and t = given amount

maximum-product-subarray.hint: Keep both the greatest and smallest product ending at the current element because a negative value can swap their roles.

neetcode.variables: n = array length

word-break.hint: Follow trie edges from reachable text positions and mark the endpoints of matching words. D is total dictionary characters and L maximum word length.

neetcode.variables: n = length of s, m = number of words in wordDict, and t = maximum length of any word in wordDict

longest-increasing-subsequence.hint: Maintain the smallest tail of an increasing subsequence at each length. Binary-search for the first tail at least as large as each new value.

neetcode.variables: n = array length

partition-equal-subset-sum.hint: If the total is even, use a descending subset-sum DP up to half the total. Descending order uses each occurrence once.

neetcode.variables: n = array length and t = half the sum of the array elements

combination-sum-iv.hint: Compute counts by increasing target sum. For each sum, try every number as the last choice so different orders count separately.

perfect-squares.hint: First test whether n is a square. Remove factors of four and apply the three-square theorem, then test whether n is a sum of two squares.

integer-break.hint: Use factors of three whenever possible, replacing a leftover one plus a three by two plus two. Handle small n separately.

stone-game-iii.hint: Compute the best score difference from each suffix. Try taking one, two or three stones and subtract the opponent's best continuation.

count-paths.hint: Count paths with the binomial coefficient choosing the positions of the shorter direction's moves. Build it multiplicatively using exact arithmetic.

neetcode.variables: m = row count and n = column count in the grid

unique-paths-ii.hint: Use one DP row of path counts. Reset blocked cells to zero and accumulate from above and left.

minimum-path-sum.hint: Add each cell's cost to the cheaper of its top and left predecessors. Reuse one row of totals.

longest-common-subsequence.hint: Compute LCS lengths for prefix pairs. Equal letters extend the diagonal prefix, otherwise take the better of the two shorter options.

neetcode.variables: m = length of text1 and n = length of text2

last-stone-weight-ii.hint: Represent achievable subset sums as bits. For each weight w, OR the current bitset with itself shifted by w. Find the reachable sum closest to half the total.

buy-and-sell-crypto-with-cooldown.hint: Track the best holding, selling and resting states day by day. A purchase can follow a resting day but cannot immediately follow a sale.

neetcode.variables: n = array length

coin-change-ii.hint: Loop over denominations first and amounts upward second to count unordered combinations with unlimited reuse.

neetcode.variables: n = number of coins and a = given amount

target-sum.hint: Convert sign assignment to subset sum for (sum + target)/2. Reject impossible parity or bounds and count subsets, including zeroes.

neetcode.variables: n = array length and m = sum of all the elements in the array

interleaving-string.hint: Use DP over prefix lengths. Each step must take the next needed character from one of the two strings; check the total length first.

neetcode.variables: m = length of s1 and n = length of s2

stone-game.hint: The even pile count and odd total let the first player guarantee the more valuable original index parity by always taking from it.

stone-game-ii.hint: Memoize the best suffix score by position and M. For each legal take subtract the opponent's best score from the remaining total.

longest-increasing-path-in-matrix.hint: Memoize the longest increasing path starting at each cell. Strict increases prevent cycles.

neetcode.variables: m = row count and n = column count

count-subsequences.hint: Count ways to form each target prefix. Scan source characters and update target positions backward so each index is used once.

neetcode.variables: m = length of s and n = length of t

edit-distance.hint: Compute edit distances for prefix pairs using insertion, deletion and replacement. Keep only the previous row and current row.

neetcode.variables: m and n are the lengths of the strings word1 and word2, respectively

burst-balloons.hint: Choose the last balloon burst in each interval. Its neighbors are then known, so combine the optimal left and right intervals.

neetcode.variables: n = array length

regular-expression-matching.hint: Use DP on text and pattern prefixes. A starred atom may be skipped, or consume one matching character while remaining available.

neetcode.variables: m = length of s and n = length of p

lemonade-change.hint: Track five- and ten-unit bills. Give change for a twenty with ten plus five whenever possible, preserving small bills for later customers.

maximum-subarray.hint: Use Kadane's recurrence: choose between starting at this value and extending the previous best ending here.

neetcode.variables: n = array length

leetcode.followUp: After the linear solution, try divide and conquer.

maximum-sum-circular-subarray.hint: Compare the maximum ordinary subarray with total minus minimum subarray. Handle all-negative input so the wrapped choice cannot be empty.

longest-turbulent-subarray.hint: Track lengths ending in an upward and a downward comparison. Ties reset both lengths.

jump-game.hint: Scan while indices remain reachable and update the farthest reachable index with each jump allowance.

neetcode.variables: n = size of input array

jump-game-ii.hint: Scan reachable ranges as BFS layers. When the current layer ends, take one more jump to the farthest position found in that layer.

neetcode.variables: n = array length

jump-game-vii.hint: Use a sliding count of reachable predecessor positions within the allowed jump interval. Mark a zero reachable if that count is positive.

gas-station.hint: Track total surplus and current segment surplus. Whenever a segment goes negative, its next index is the next candidate start.

neetcode.variables: n = array length

hand-of-straights.hint: Count card multiplicities and process sorted distinct starts. Whenever a start has c copies left, reserve c copies of each value in its consecutive group.

neetcode.variables: n = array length

dota2-senate.hint: Maintain queues of Radiant and Dire turn indices. The earlier index bans the other and rejoins with index increased by the original length.

merge-triplets-to-form-target.hint: Discard triplets exceeding any target coordinate. Check whether each target coordinate appears in at least one surviving triplet.

neetcode.variables: n = array length

bounds: 1 ≤ a i , b i , c i , x, y, z ≤ 1000

partition-labels.hint: Record the last occurrence of each letter. Extend a part to cover all last occurrences it reaches and cut when the scan reaches its boundary.

neetcode.variables: n = length of s and m = number of unique characters in the string s

valid-parenthesis-string.hint: Track the lowest and highest possible unmatched-open counts through the scan. Clamp the low bound at zero and reject a negative high bound.

neetcode.variables: n = length

candy.hint: Scan slopes, counting the lengths of rising and falling runs. Give the shared peak enough candies for the larger slope and count flat ratings once each.

insert-new-interval.hint: Copy intervals before the insertion, merge all intervals that overlap it, then append the remaining intervals.

neetcode.variables: n = array length

merge-intervals.hint: Sort by start and merge any next interval starting before or at the current end.

neetcode.variables: n = array length

non-overlapping-intervals.hint: Select compatible intervals by earliest finishing time. Subtract the number kept from the original count.

neetcode.variables: n = array length

meeting-schedule.hint: Sort meetings by start time and check whether any start precedes the end of the previous meeting.

neetcode.variables: n = array length

meeting-schedule-ii.hint: Sort start and end times separately. Sweep them together, processing ends before equal-time starts, and track maximum simultaneous meetings.

neetcode.variables: n = array length

meeting-rooms-iii.hint: Sort by start time. Track free rooms in an index heap and busy rooms by release time then index. Delay a meeting when all rooms are busy.

neetcode.time: O(m log m + m log n)

minimum-interval-including-query.hint: Sort queries with their original indices and intervals by start. Maintain a min-heap by inclusive length and discard expired candidates before answering each query.

neetcode.time: O(n log n + m log m)
neetcode.variables: m = size of the array queries and n = size of the array intervals

excel-sheet-column-title.hint: Subtract one before each base-26 remainder to account for letters being numbered from one. Collect letters in reverse order.

greatest-common-divisor-of-strings.hint: Use the gcd of the two lengths as the candidate prefix length. Compare every character with the corresponding position in that repeated prefix. Create the output string only if all comparisons pass.

insert-greatest-common-divisors-in-linke.hint: At each original pair insert a node containing the Euclidean gcd, then advance directly to the next original node. V is the largest value.

transpose-matrix.hint: Create the output with swapped dimensions and copy each cell to its reversed pair of indices.

rotate-matrix.hint: Transpose across the main diagonal, then reverse each row in place.

neetcode.variables: n = length of the side of the given square matrix

leetcode.requirement: Rotate in place without a second matrix.

spiral-matrix.hint: Shrink top, right, bottom and left bounds as each outer edge is visited. Check bounds before walking the last row or column twice.

neetcode.variables: m = row count and n = column count

set-zeroes-in-matrix.hint: Use the first row and column as markers. Save whether they initially contained a zero, mark the remaining matrix, then apply markers in a second pass.

neetcode.variables: m = row count and n = column count

non-cyclical-number.hint: Use Floyd's cycle detection on the sum-of-squared-digits transformation. If the cycle reaches one, return true.

neetcode.variables: n = given integer

plus-one.hint: Propagate a carry from the least significant digit. Stop when the carry clears, and prepend one if it survives every digit.

neetcode.variables: n = array length

roman-to-integer.hint: Scan digit values and subtract any symbol that precedes a larger symbol. Otherwise add it.

pow-x-n.hint: Use exponentiation by squaring. Square the base each step, multiply the result when the exponent bit is set, and invert the base for negative powers.

neetcode.variables: n = given integer

multiply-strings.hint: Accumulate digit-pair products into an array indexed by place value and propagate carries to produce the decimal digits.

neetcode.variables: m = length of num1 and n = length of num2

count-squares.hint: Store point frequencies. For a query choose a possible opposite corner on a nonzero diagonal, then multiply frequencies of the other two corners and the opposite corner.

neetcode.variables: n = total number of points

single-number.hint: XOR the entries. Paired values cancel and the unpaired value remains.

neetcode.variables: n = array length

leetcode.requirement: O(n) time and O(1) additional space.

number-of-one-bits.hint: Clear the lowest set bit with n AND (n−1) until n is zero.

counting-bits.hint: For each i use the count at i shifted right by one, plus its least significant bit.

neetcode.variables: n = given integer

leetcode.followUp: Try a single pass in O(n) time.

add-binary.hint: Walk the strings from the right, emitting the low bit of each digit sum and carrying the rest. Reverse the output buffer once.

reverse-bits.hint: Read and shift one bit at a time for exactly 32 iterations, treating the result as unsigned.

missing-number.hint: XOR each index and its value together with n. All present values cancel with their indices.

neetcode.variables: n = array length

leetcode.followUp: O(n) time and O(1) extra space.

sum-of-two-integers.hint: XOR gives the partial sum and shifted AND gives the carry. Repeat until no carry remains. Limit operations to the chosen signed width, including in Python.

reverse-integer.hint: Pop decimal digits and accumulate the reversed value. Check the signed 32-bit bound as digits are appended.

bitwise-and-of-numbers-range.hint: Right-shift both endpoints until they share a prefix, then shift the prefix back. Bits below the first difference are cleared in the range AND.

minimum-array-end.hint: Preserve all one-bits of x and place the bits of n−1 into x's zero positions from least to most significant. Use exact wide integers during construction.
